title: Rimac Nevera in the Night Studio on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Small work, done daily, gets loud over time.
description:
Step into the quiet warmth of the Night Studio, where a giallo yellow Rimac Nevera sits bathed in soft shadows. Outside, gentle rain streaks down the glass, dissolving the city lights into a dreamy, blurred glow. All you will hear for the next two hours is calm ambient electronic music, woven with warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and an easy beat. Settle in, make yourself comfortable, and let this space carry you through working, studying, or simply relaxing.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
